product_one_liner.value: Leena AI provides enterprises with AI colleagues that resolve employee requests and automate workflows across HR, IT, finance, and procurement.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes enterprise AI colleagues for IT, HR, finance and procurement; its announcement explains that they resolve employee requests and execute workflows across existing systems. Sources: https://leena.ai/about-us and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ibm-ventures-invests-in-leena-ai-to-accelerate-agentic-ai-across-the-enterprise-back-office-302914251.html

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes Universal Assistant licensing, platform fees and usage-based pricing, even though a final quote is customized. Source: https://leena.ai/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage promotes a CHRISTUS Health adoption case study and includes a Beacon Mobility testimonial describing its use of Leena AI colleagues. Source: https://leena.ai/ | named_customers.0: The homepage links to a case study about CHRISTUS Health's AI adoption across 51,000 employees. Source: https://leena.ai/ | named_customers.1: The Beacon Mobility testimonial describes adopting Leena AI colleagues and using password-reset automation. Source: https://leena.ai/

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 327 employees, placing it in the 201–500 band. Associated-profile counts can differ from payroll headcount. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/leena-ai

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's announcement explicitly states that Leena AI is headquartered in New York. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ibm-ventures-invests-in-leena-ai-to-accelerate-agentic-ai-across-the-enterprise-back-office-302914251.html | hq_country: The company's New York address and its United States identification support the country. Sources: https://leena.ai/pricing and https://www.theofficialboard.com/org-chart/leena-ai?showSubsidiary=open

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states that it was founded in 2018. Source: https://leena.ai/about-us

eng_blog.notes: Two qualifying technical posts describe an open-source agent benchmark and the engineering team's PDF-pipeline overhaul. Benchmark author Shubham Agarwal is identified as VP of Engineering; PDF-post coauthor Akshat Gupta is identified as a machine-learning engineer. Sources: https://leena.ai/blog/how-do-we-benchmark-an-agentic-ai-system-heres-our-approach-fully-open ; https://blog.leena.ai/enterprise-grade-pdf-parsing-pipelines-accuracy-speed-and-scale-for-2025 ; https://linkedin.com/in/akshat-gupta-a82923227

public_docs.notes: The public documentation links to multiple distinct articles, including AI Colleagues Studio, Workflows Studio and Knowledge Management. Source: https://docs.leena.ai/docs/welcome-to-leena-ai

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live AI Engineer posting specifies LLMs, agentic AI, prompt engineering, RAG and tool calling. Source: https://jobs.greycroft.com/companies/leena-ai/jobs/86102009-ai-engineer

model_provider.value: WorkLM™, GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5, and Llama 4.
model_provider.notes: The Orchestrator page explicitly names all five models as supported reasoning models. Source: https://leena.ai/platform/orchestrator

Sources: https://leena.ai/blog/ibm-ventures-leena-ai-investment and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ibm-ventures-invests-in-leena-ai-to-accelerate-agentic-ai-across-the-enterprise-back-office-302914251.html | funding_amount_usd: The latest strategic investment's terms were not disclosed, so its USD amount is unknown rather than zero. raised_18mo.notes: The IBM Ventures strategic investment announced in October 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window. Sources: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ibm-ventures-invests-in-leena-ai-to-accelerate-agentic-ai-across-the-enterprise-back-office-302914251.html and https://leena.ai/blog/ibm-ventures-leena-ai-investment

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Senior Account Executive – Enterprise posting has an October 2, 2026 posting date and an application link. Source: https://apply.workable.com/leena-ai/jobs/view/01DB703E7F.md

launched_6mo.notes: The October 14, 2026 introduction says Leena Forge is live that day and describes its ability to build, connect and test automations. This is a substantive launch within six months. Source: https://leena.ai/blog/introducing-leenaai-forge

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brent Ludwig's profile dates his Leena AI VP of Professional Services role to September 2026, within the requested 12-month window. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/bludwig
